newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Ultronics shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Ultronics shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Ultronics International Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Thursday.
Shares in the medical and scientific equipment distributor surged HK$0.23 or 46 percent to HK$0.73 in early trade prior to the trading suspension.
Volume was 11.77 million shares worth HK$7.84 million.

Ultronics had said earlier its controlling shareholders were in talks to merge or sell their stake in the company to an independent third party, which might result in a general offer for the company's shares.
